author: GH-Jaider

brief.en: Nine corners in a line and a wall at the end. Walk Karel to the far corner without counting the steps by hand.
brief.es: Nueve esquinas en fila y un muro al final. Lleva a Karel hasta la última esquina sin contar los pasos a mano.

solution:
BEGINNING-OF-PROGRAM
    BEGINNING-OF-EXECUTION
        WHILE front-is-clear DO
            move;
        turnoff
    END-OF-EXECUTION
END-OF-PROGRAM
